name: io.github.TheStreamCode/discord-management-mcp
description: Safe-by-default Discord management MCP with JSON backups, restore planning, and guarded mutations.

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Discord bot token from Developer Portal > Bot > Token.

environmentVariables.name: BACKUP_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Relative directory for local JSON backups. It must stay inside the project directory.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Stderr log level: error, warn, info, or debug.

environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_MESSAGE_CONTENT
environmentVariables.description: Enables message-content tools and requires the Discord Message Content intent.

environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_GUILD_MEMBERS
environmentVariables.description: Enables the Guild Members gateway intent.
